candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory failing with timeout/DependencyUnavailable, causing inventory /v1/reservations 503 and order ReadTimeout, propagating 502 to gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs; root cause of the redis timeout (load, saturation, network) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout correlation failing at redis.reserve_inventory with timeout, inventory returning 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway 502 at ~2s. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis. Bounded candidate is redis-timeout; redis-side telemetry is missing to confirm the underlying cause.
missing_evidence: Redis/inventory dependency metrics and logs to confirm redis latency and rule out other causes
Order service logs to confirm the ReadTimeout originates from inventory's redis call
